tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background. Listing cards sit directly on it with no border; the grid gap and the photo block separate them.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: input fields, filter bar, image placeholders, table stripes, the ended timer.

tokens.name: bg-900
tokens.usage: Inverted surfaces: the primary Buy button, the Auction badge, the urgent countdown. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body copy on `bg-000` and `bg-100`. Warm near-black, never pure #000.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `bg-000` and `bg-100`: seller, location, condition, timestamps, helper text. 5.8:1 light / 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `bg-900`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Strong 1px border, ONLY on controls that must read as pressable: outlined buttons, inputs, unselected chips. Never around cards or sections.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The everyday hairline: list separators, table rules, the edge of a sheet or dialog. Separation without a box.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: MONEY and GO. The only accent that fills: the Bid button, selected filter chips, the running countdown. Text on it is `on-blue`. 6.4:1 on `bg-000` in both themes, so it needs no border.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `blue` fill. 6.7:1 light / 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text: the current bid amount, links, 'Höchstgebot'. On `bg-000` and `bg-100`. 8.1:1 light / 9.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: SUSTAINABILITY, as text and thin marks only: 'Grüne Wahl' (outlined badge), the CO₂ line, success messages. Never a button, never a fill, never a tinted ground. 7.3:1 light / 9.8:1 dark on `bg-000`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. Drawn on the surrounding ground, never inside a fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Semantic only, never branding: 'Du wurdest überboten', validation errors, 'Inserat entfernt'. Always with a word or icon. 7.6:1 / 8.1:1 on `bg-000`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and dialogs.

color.note: Five neutrals, two accents, one semantic. No tints: an accent is either a solid fill (blue only) or text. Nothing else is coloured.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Campaign and landing headlines only. One per screen.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, listing title on the detail page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Gebraucht, aber tadellos. Abholung in Winterthur oder Versand.
styles.usage: Descriptions, messages, forms. Never below 16px for input text on mobile.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, listing titles in cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, badges, table headers. Always uppercase with this tracking.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in cards and lists. Set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so columns align.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: The price or current bid on the detail page.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Auction countdowns. Tabular numerals; never animates size.

spacing.note: 4px base. Touch targets are at least 44px tall; page gutter is space-4 on phones, space-6 from 720px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, input padding, card inner padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, gap between cards, card padding from 720px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing, page gutter from 720px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and landing spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of landing pages on desktop.

radius.note: Zweit is square. 2px keeps corners from aliasing on high-DPI screens; it is not a visible rounding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Images, image placeholders, full-bleed blocks, the cover.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Every control and container: buttons, inputs, chips, badges, cards, dialogs. Never larger.

border.note: Borders are for controls, not containers. Cards and sections separate by spacing, the photo block and `line-soft` rules. No box-shadow anywhere.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Default border on cards, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Focus ring and the selected state of chips and tabs.
